items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Where, what was her name? What was your mother's name? Rosa, R-O-S-A.

ctx.x: In Pinecombeet Parish, you know, New Road. New Road. And, I don't really know when my mother was born, but I know my father was 17 years older than she was.
Where, what was her name? What was your mother's name? Rosa, R-O-S-A.
And what, what was your last name? Well, a man named Jackson.
